claims.text: Reachy Nova ships a conceptual architecture instruction page: layers, ownership, communication seams, cognition tiers and invariants of the on-device harness — readers understand the system without reading code

docs/architecture.md (55 lines, the legacy ReachyMiniApp/app_state view, linked from README.md:29) is replaced by a harness-era conceptual page; the legacy direct-SDK path stays as one closing section

the page stays at concept level (tiers, ownership, seams, cognition tiers, invariants, walkthroughs); per-file and per-function detail remains in docs/components/*.md and CLAUDE.md's module map, which the page links to

the on-device harness over reachy-mini-cli's symbolic runtime is THE architecture; main.py's direct-SDK ReachyMiniApp is superseded (scope plan P5: retire after the wireless harness is proven, which round 2 + kiro-writer deliveries did)

the seams table and internal-structure sections are sourced from reachy_nova/harness/{supervisor,bus,gate,hearing,speaking,statedir,tools,rules_overlay,kiro_session,forge_leg,unit}.py and reachy_nova/kiro_acp.py — every channel named with direction and payload shape

network (iPhone (5) hotspot) and Kiro-session verification are live operational checks on the CM4, recorded in the session, not spec content; the page documents the network/boot model only conceptually

scope_entries.finding: existing page describes the retired monolith (ReachyMiniApp, app_state dict, YOLO tracker); it is the only architecture entry point linked from README, so the new page must replace it in place, not sit beside it
17 component docs already carry file-level detail (skill-forge, speech-events, tracking, patting, ...); duplicating them would drift — the architecture page links down instead

single-owner SDK constraint, seams (MQTT reachy/events/#, audio tee, intents spool, rules overlay, daemon HTTP) and the P5 retirement of the direct-SDK path are recorded decisions; kiro-writer delivery proves the harness live on the CM4

harness = supervisor + start/stop units + MQTT bus + tee hearing + daemon-HTTP speaking + legs (vision/memory/forge/cognition_feed) + 11-tool surface; boundary AST-enforced (no reachy_mini import, no set_target); every seam lives in statedir.py

iPhone (5) profile existed with PSK but timestamp 0 (never joined) — join proven live 07:33 BST; kiro_session failed at boot (kiro-cli exited before network-online) and the pre-review build never retried; main carries the spawn-survival fix
